<?php
/**
 * Session Token Validator
 * Validates HMAC-based session tokens with sliding window for clock skew
 */

class TokenValidator {
    private string $secretKey;
    private int $windowSize;
    private array $usedNonces = [];
    
    public function __construct(string $secretKey, int $windowSize = 300) {
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
        $this->windowSize = $windowSize;
    }
    
    /**
     * Parse a token string into components
     * Format: base64(timestamp:nonce:role:signature)
     */
    public function parseToken(string $rawToken): ?array {
        $decoded = base64_decode($rawToken, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $parts = explode(':', $decoded);
        if (count($parts) !== 4) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return [
            'timestamp' => $parts[0],
            'nonce' => $parts[1],
            'role' => $parts[2],
            'signature' => $parts[3]
        ];
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify the HMAC signature of token components
     */
    public function verifySignature(array $tokenParts): bool {
        $message = $tokenParts['timestamp'] . ':' . $tokenParts['nonce'] . ':' . $tokenParts['role'];
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $message, $this->secretKey);
        return hash_equals($expectedSig, $tokenParts['signature']);
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if timestamp is within acceptable window
     */
    public function isTimestampValid(string $timestamp): bool {
        $tokenTime = (int)$timestamp;
        $currentTime = time();
        $diff = abs($currentTime - $tokenTime);
        return $diff <= $this->windowSize;
    }
    
    /**
     * Anti-replay: check if nonce was already used
     */
    public function isNonceUnused(string $nonce): bool {
        if (in_array($nonce, $this->usedNonces, true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->usedNonces[] = $nonce;
        // Prune old nonces to prevent memory growth
        if (count($this->usedNonces) > 10000) {
            $this->usedNonces = array_slice($this->usedNonces, -5000);
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate role is a known role
     */
    public function isValidRole(string $role): bool {
        $allowedRoles = ['guest', 'user', 'moderator', 'admin'];
        return in_array($role, $allowedRoles, true);
    }
    
    /**
     * Full token validation pipeline
     */
    public function validate(string $rawToken): array {
        $parts = $this->parseToken($rawToken);
        if ($parts === null) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'error' => 'malformed token'];
        }
        
        if (!$this->isTimestampValid($parts['timestamp'])) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'error' => 'token expired'];
        }
        
        if (!$this->isNonceUnused($parts['nonce'])) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'error' => 'replay detected'];
        }
        
        if (!$this->verifySignature($parts)) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'error' => 'invalid signature'];
        }
        
        if (!$this->isValidRole($parts['role'])) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'error' => 'invalid role'];
        }
        
        return ['valid' => true, 'role' => $parts['role']];
    }
}

/**
 * Role-based access control using validated tokens
 */
class AccessController {
    private const ROLE_HIERARCHY = [
        'guest' => 0,
        'user' => 1,
        'moderator' => 2,
        'admin' => 3
    ];
    
    private const PROTECTED_ACTIONS = [
        'read' => 'guest',
        'write' => 'user',
        'moderate' => 'moderator',
        'admin_panel' => 'admin',
        'delete_user' => 'admin',
        'system_config' => 'admin'
    ];
    
    private TokenValidator $validator;
    
    public function __construct(TokenValidator $validator) {
        $this->validator = $validator;
    }
    
    /**
     * Get numeric level for a role string
     */
    public function getRoleLevel(string $role): int {
        if (!isset(self::ROLE_HIERARCHY[$role])) {
            return -1;
        }
        return self::ROLE_HIERARCHY[$role];
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if user role meets minimum required role for action
     */
    public function checkPermission(string $userRole, string $action): bool {
        if (!isset(self::PROTECTED_ACTIONS[$action])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $requiredRole = self::PROTECTED_ACTIONS[$action];
        $userLevel = $this->getRoleLevel($userRole);
        $requiredLevel = $this->getRoleLevel($requiredRole);
        
        // Safe: reject unknown roles explicitly before comparison
        if ($userLevel < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        if ($userLevel >= $requiredLevel) {
            return true;
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Main authorization entry point
     */
    public function authorize(string $rawToken, string $action): array {
        $validation = $this->validator->validate($rawToken);
        
        if (!$validation['valid']) {
            return ['authorized' => false, 'reason' => $validation['error']];
        }
        
        $role = $validation['role'];
        
        if ($this->checkPermission($role, $action)) {
            return ['authorized' => true, 'role' => $role, 'action' => $action];
        }
        
        return ['authorized' => false, 'reason' => 'insufficient privileges'];
    }
}

/**
 * Request handler
 */
class RequestHandler {
    private AccessController $acl;
    
    public function __construct(AccessController $acl) {
        $this->acl = $acl;
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        $token = $request['token'] ?? '';
        $action = $request['action'] ?? '';
        
        if (empty($token) || empty($action)) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'message' => 'Missing token or action'];
        }
        
        $result = $this->acl->authorize($token, $action);
        
        if ($result['authorized']) {
            return ['status' => 200, 'message' => 'Action permitted', 'data' => $result];
        }
        
        return ['status' => 403, 'message' => 'Access denied', 'data' => $result];
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
$secretKey = getenv('TOKEN_SECRET');
if (!$secretKey || strlen($secretKey) < 32) {
    error_log('TOKEN_SECRET environment variable must be set with at least 32 characters');
    http_response_code(500);
    exit(1);
}
$validator = new TokenValidator($secretKey);
$controller = new AccessController($validator);
$handler = new RequestHandler($controller);

// Process incoming request
$input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
if ($input) {
    $response = $handler->handleRequest($input);
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($response);
}
